import 'package:hazard_fixture/background.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  // weigh() only ever runs in the other isolate.
  test('weighs elsewhere', () async {
    expect(await weighElsewhere([5, 20]), 45);
  });

  test('surcharge', () {
    expect(surcharge(60), 6);
    expect(surcharge(50), 0);
  });
}
